text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Peace peace♪
It's a victory, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Peace peace♪
It's a victory, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Being number one really is special, isn't it~!
I just can't stop getting excited!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching closely?
Watching how I ran!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~?
Look who finally gets it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, as a treat today, maybe I'll drop by
a cafe for a lemonade and some tiramisu.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course you're coming along too, Trainer-kun, right?
Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course you're coming with me too, right, Trainer-chan?
Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you, Trainer-kun,
aren't you a smooth talker!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you, Trainer-chan,
aren't you a smooth talker!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right, though—I can't be satisfied here!
I just didn't have enough spirit!
Saying that, Maruzensky chugged down her favorite nata de coco juice in one go!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm wide awake! I'm gonna
keep giving it my all with tons of energy!
